item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day has a lot of quiet check-ins built in, and water fits right into them. Most people feel tired or foggy and blame stress when they're simply under-hydrated. Water also makes it easier to stay clear-headed when you're working on your patterns. Don't wait until you're thirsty. Tie it to routines you already do. Action: drink a full glass of water right now, before your morning meditation.
